summary: Stevanato Group filed a Form 6-K announcing results of its ordinary and extraordinary shareholders' meeting on May 26, 2026. Resolutions passed included approval of annual financial statements, dividend of EUR 0.054 per share, re-election of directors (with one new member), appointment of PricewaterhouseCoopers as auditor for 2026-2028, authorization for treasury share purchases/disposals, and by-law amendments concerning beneficial shareholder rights, board slates, and audit committee flexibility. This is a routine corporate governance update and not a special situation. The filing is a standard current report under Rule 13a-16, equivalent to a Form 8-K for non-US issuers."
